stances.quote: In Congress, I work to maintain the military installations on the Central Coast, promote their educational training and technological innovation, and protect their nearly 15,000 good-paying jobs that impact the economy of our communities and the safety of our country.
stances.reasoning: Text shows repeated support for maintaining and protecting military installations and jobs, indicating preference for more defense spending.

stances.quote: As a Member of the House Ways and Means Committee, I continue my work to open new markets around the world for our producers while easing the tax burden on family farms to ensure they can continue to support our community.
stances.reasoning: Explicit mention of easing tax burden supports lower taxes.
No clear statement on deficit size or balancing the budget.

stances.quote: As a member of the Ways and Means Committee, I was proud to help formulate and pass into law legislation that addressed that issue head-on, with stronger protections for seniors that will result in lower costs at the pharmacy counter.
